title: Gibran Museum

terrainReference.basis: Independent terrain at the lower southwest terrace near the east addition. Terrace grade and the floor offsets are approximate.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap named Gibran Museum and adjacent access road and Lebanon Mountain Trail.
mapIdentity.scope: The named six-corner museum polygon fixes the main envelope, and the signed southwest direction agrees with the native approach road and photographer’s caption.

note: In the cleared photograph, the low southeast addition extends in front of the former monastery’s taller stepped masonry, with a continuous path and stairs. Natural limestone crowds the rear and rises above roof height.
